title: EWG reveals its Dirty Dozen; AFF challenges validity of list
summary: Trade news item on the 2026 Dirty Dozen and Clean 15, noting all listed produce is below legal residue limits, organic farming also uses some pesticides, and an industry group disputes the list.

assertions.quote: organic fruits and vegetables are allowed to be produced using certain chemical pesticides
all of the fruits and vegetables on its Dirty Dozen list are well below the allowable limits for pesticide residue
